newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-VIERI MOVES TO ATLETICO FOR $20 MILLION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VIERI MOVES TO ATLETICO FOR $20 MILLION.

text.p: Italian champions Juventus sold striker Christian Vieri to Atletico Madrid for $20 million on Wednesday and signed Uruguyan Daniel Fonseca from Roma.
Juve also said they had completed the sale of Croatian striker Alen Boksic to Rome side Lazio.
The signings mean Juve's formidable first-choice forward line for next season appears complete.

Fonseca will join last season's serie A top scorer Filippo Inzaghi, who joined the Turin club from Atalanta last month, and Alessandro Del Piero, a key figure in Juve's rebirth over the past three seasons.
"We've sold Vieri and bought Fonseca," Juventus general manager Luciano Moggi confirmed on Wednesday. He declined to say how much the club had paid for Fonseca.
He said Vieri, who had been linked to Atletico for several weeks, had signed a four-year contract with the Spanish side after a meeting in Rome between officials of the two clubs.
Moggi insisted Juventus had not wanted to sell Vieri, a powerful centre forward who struck up a fluent partnership with Del Piero last season.
"It was his own decision to go," Moggi said.
Vieri appears to have been worried about losing his first team place to Inzaghi, who took serie A by storm last season, scoring 24 league goals for little-fancied Atalanta.
Only last week Vieri said Juventus would be crazy not to sell him for the price Atletico had reportedly offered.
Juve had repeatedly said Vieri, who also joined them from Atalanta, would not be sold this summer but they also acknowledged every player had his price.
Fonseca arrives in Turin after three seasons with Roma. Before that he was at Napoli and Calgiari.
Boksic, a regular Juve first team player when he first arrived at the club last season, returns to Lazio where he launched his serie A career four years ago.
